'''Herkuun''' was a heavyset [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the position of [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] in the military forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. He was one of the commanders of a Thul force that invaded the [[Apalis Fields]] and the [[Organa Vinerium]] on the [[Apalis Coast]], but he was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.
